text:
Leonora Neuffer Bilger was awarded the Francis P. Garvan–John M. Olin Medal in 1953, according to her [Wikipedia biography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leonora_Bilger) and the [Garvan–Olin Medal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Garvan%E2%80%93Olin_Medal) recipient list. Neither 1961 nor 1947 appears in these sources, and the note's claim that the medal was first awarded in 1936 doesn't match them either.

CONFIDENCE: 93
